Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the next town after Mummulgum along the Bruxner Highway is Lismore. In reality, the town immediately following Mummulgum is Casino, which is situated on the Richmond River. By assuming Lismore to be the next town, the Planner misdirected the WebSurfer to gather information about the wrong river, leading to the collection of irrelevant data regarding the Wilsons River instead of the Richmond River. This error in identifying the correct town and river is the root cause of the incorrect solution to the problem.
